resources.string: Make Call Manager your call-screening app
Android only lets one app screen incoming calls. Taking that role is what lets Call Manager silence or reject calls that match your rules. It does not replace your phone app.
Allow access to calls and contacts
Call log access shows your recent and blocked calls, contacts access lets known people through, and phone state detects calls you answer. Everything stays on this device.

Some phone makers stop apps in the background, which can prevent Android from reaching Call Manager when a call arrives. Exempting it from battery optimization avoids that and does not keep anything running.
Call Manager isn\'t your call-screening app, so calls aren\'t being screened.
Call Manager is missing permissions it needs to work.
